title: Variational Cognitive Memory Abstraction for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.34251v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet their ability to execute long-horizon tasks remains limited by insufficient long- term memory modeling. Existing methods either rely on implicit temporal representations within policy networks, where historical information can be gradually diluted, or maintain explicit memory buffers that suffer from redundancy, noise accumulation, and inefficient retrieval. In this paper, we propose CogMemory, a novel variational cognitive memory framework that enables VLA systems to selectively preserve and reuse task-relevant historical information. Our approach encodes multimodal trajectories into compact latent memory representations through a selective state- space memory encoder, multi-slot temporal abstraction, and variational information compression. translated_title: 面向长时程视觉-语言-动作模型的变分认知记忆抽象
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务中已展现出卓越的性能，但其执行长时程任务的能力仍受限于长期记忆建模的不足。现有方法要么依赖于策略网络内部的隐式时序表示，导致历史信息逐渐被稀释；要么采用显式记忆缓冲区，却面临冗余、噪声积累和检索效率低下等问题。在本文中，我们提出了CogMemory，一种新颖的变分认知记忆框架，使VLA系统能够选择性地保留并复用与任务相关的历史信息。我们的方法通过选择性状态空间记忆编码器、多槽时序抽象和变分信息压缩，将多模态轨迹编码为紧凑的潜在记忆表示。在动作生成阶段，带有门控融合的动态交叉注意力检索机制自适应地整合相关记忆信息……
tldr: 提出CogMemory变分认知记忆框架，通过选择性状态空间记忆编码、多槽时序抽象和变分信息压缩，使视觉-语言-动作模型能够选择性保留和复用任务相关历史信息，从而提升长时程机器人操作任务的执行能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes CogMemory, a variational cognitive memory framework that enables VLA models to selectively preserve and reuse task-relevant historical information via selective state-space memory encoding, multi-slot temporal abstraction, and variational information compression, thereby improving long-horizon robotic manipulation.
